reading_note: The teaching traces a sequence of divine providential sendings, each preceding and providing for a stage of spiritual separation. Before evil and good were distinguished as states (night and day), the call from the celestial degree was sent to purify the light caught in the natural and to separate truth from falsity. Before the proprium ruled the natural-bodily plane, the Judge of divine truth was placed in the medium of spiritual perception to discriminate the regenerate from the evil. Before doctrinal falsity overran the church, divine truth itself (Christ) was sent to cut down error. Before men were sorted into receivers and non-receivers and consigned to the cyclic states of recompense (stars and spheres), the order of judgment-by-works was already provided. Finally, before the consummation of the present order, releasers are appointed to undo it, and the First Architect with His angels is appointed to build the new heaven. The single arc: divine providence anticipates every stage of separation with a corresponding influx and agent.
